title: The Adaptive Logistics Advantage Report
summary: Discover how adaptive logistics can help your business respond to disruption, improve decision-making and build operational flexibility. Download the GXO report.
body_markdown:
**Report**


# **Is your logistics model built to adapt?**


[Download the guide](https://gxo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/GXO-Adaptive-Logistics-Advantage-report.pdf)


## Supply chain pressure is creating a level of disruption that standard logistics models are not built to handle


**To help businesses adapt to what is happening now and what is coming next, logistics must play a different role. This guide helps leaders assess whether their logistics model is creating more options—or quietly forcing tradeoffs.**


### What you’ll learn


- How to identify where your logistics model is creating constraints or forcing tradeoffs
- How leading organizations are building logistics models that preserve options, support faster decisions and align to specific business needs
- How to pressure-test your own logistics model and identify where it may need to evolve


## **Pressure is coming from every direction**


When asked which external forces have the biggest impact on operations, brand leaders point to several pressures at once:


## 69%


**Labor availability**


## 35%


**Shifts in demand**


## 33%


**Technology limitations**


**Adaptability has become a core logistics requirement—not just a seasonal advantage.**


Source: Fulfillment Strategies for a Volatile World, GXO and Retail Dive


## ****Ready to pressure-test your logistics model?****


View the guide to see what a more adaptive model looks like.
